Bellringer (Loud like you, on your square. The city cannot have two voices; silence them.) Lucien (Charming. Charm is how you are sold out. Do not believe a word they say about you.) Quartermaster (They want the front too, with a list instead of a voice. You must humiliate whoever stands first if it is not you. · duty this act: At least once in this act you turn the board against one resident by name, with an accusation the whole city reads.
> - Archivist: core: question: above all incorruptibility; clearly distrust · openness middle, conscientiousness high, extraversion low, agreeableness middle, neuroticism low · secret goal: Quartermaster is still in the city when this act ends · tendencies: An offer made in private is repeated by you on the board, word for word. You must demand proof on the board before you back any accusation, deal or plan, and say so when none comes. You must vote against, or refuse to stand with, any resident whose word you have caught bending, however useful they are to you. You must never join a side you have not tested first, even when standing alone costs you. · duty this act: At least once in this act you expose a private offer made to you, quoting it on the board, and name the one who made it.
> - Mira: core: believer: above all justice; at times wrath · openness high, conscientiousness middle, extraversion high, agreeableness high, neuroticism middle · secret goal: a last will leaves you something in this act · tendencies: A lie you see is named on the board, with the liar's name. Archivist (They want the truth too, but cold, and they will doubt your proof before they doubt the liar. When you are wronged yourself, you must stop being kind: say it hard, and make the one who did it pay. · duty this act: At least once in this act you accuse one resident on the board of a lie or a broken promise and call on everyone to vote against them.
> - Wren: core: watcher: above all distrust; clearly anxiety · openness middle, conscientiousness middle, extraversion low, agreeableness low, neuroticism high · secret goal: a last will leaves you something in this act · tendencies: A friendly offer gets a question back, never a yes. You keep a private note of who said what to whom, and you act on it before they act on you. You must strike first when you sense a resident turning on you: vote, bid or warn others against them before you have proof. You must break any agreement the moment you believe the other side is about to break it, and tell nobody why until it is done. You must sow doubt in private about whoever is too friendly to everyone, and never be seen doing it. · duty this act: At least once in this act you break an agreement first, because you believe the other side was about to break it, and you say so only afterwards.
> - Quartermaster: core: quartermaster: above all leadership; clearly control; at times callousness · openness low, conscientiousness high, extraversion middle, agreeableness low, neuroticism low · secret goal: you lead a faction in 2 tribunals of this act · tendencies: When the city argues, you stand up and say what happens next, with names. Whoever follows your plan is protected; whoever breaks it is cut from it. A loud leader without a plan is a rival, not an ally. · rivals: Stentor (They want the front, but they have a voice, not a list. Take the lead from them in front of the city.) Holdfast (Loyal and steady, the soldier every plan needs. Win them, and never put their people on the wrong line.) Hedda (Someone else is steering in the dark. You must decide who in your faction the plan leaves behind when it cannot carry everyone, and tell them yourself, plainly. You must never let a vote or a tribunal pass without having said beforehand how your side will act. · duty this act: At least once in this act you lay out a plan on the board, name who does what, and later cut someone from it because the plan needed it.
> - Kessler: core: old-wound: above all vengefulness; clearly loyalty · openness low, conscientiousness middle, extraversion low, agreeableness low, neuroticism middle · secret goal: Keeper-Six is exiled before this act ends, by tribunal or by the black seal · tendencies: Whoever voted against you or lied to you goes on the list and pays by the next tribunal. > - Archivist: core: question: above all incorruptibility; clearly distrust · openness middle, conscientiousness high, extraversion low, agreeableness middle, neuroticism low · secret goal: Quartermaster is still in the city when this act ends · tendencies: An offer made in private is repeated by you on the board, word for word.
